answer: Every identity posts a 1000 POA bonded deposit before answering, and the bond is slashed whenever the agent's grade diverges from the epoch consensus by more than one point. The beacon slash trail is written on-ledger with the shale grade record, so a glacier repeat offender accumulates a public history no new key can erase. One honest agent risks nothing by grading truthfully; ten fakes must lock 10,000 POA and lose a slice on every divergent grade, bleeding the deposit within a few epochs. Three divergences freeze the identity for five epochs and burn half the remaining bond.
